messages:
anna: heads-up — i'm kicking off a config-only roll for routing + batching + kv-ttl now. canary traffic: 5% EU + 5% US for 15m. keeping model routing pinned to fast-lex-v1 for the canary to avoid variant flips :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deploy queued by anna: config-only/slim-kv-routing-2026-03-22. status: STARTING_CANARY -> canary on subset (5% eu,5% us). canary_id=canary-7341592653. use `/deploy abort canary-7341592653` to cancel. link: https://deploys.internal/canary-7341592653

kevin: ack. watching latency dashboards. rollback criteria I want in ops checklist: p95 token latency > 1.1s for 3m OR 5xx rate > 0.5% for 3m -> immediate rollback. also watch kv miss rate; if it climbs >10% over baseline also consider rollback.

priya: observability note: i've refreshed the dashboards and created a short eval set to smoke-check generation quality vs baseline. will post results in ~10m.

devex-jamie: note for release notes / changelog: batching_window_ms reduced 25->15, max_concurrency soft-limited 8->6, routing bias increased for fast-lex-v1 in regions, kv_cache_ttl 600->300. add a doc blurb about potential small cost uptick for tiny requests.

deploy-bot: canary update (t+3m) for canary-7341592653: p50=88ms, p95=1.02s, errors(5xx)=0.12%, kv_miss_rate=baseline*1.03. no alerts fired.

sam: saw a micro bump in kv cache misses in eu-west at t+2m. expected given TTL shrink. for clarity: what's the explicit rollback trigger for kv misses? propose kv_miss_rate > baseline * 1.10 AND p95 > 1.1s as combined signal.

kevin: +1 to sam's combined rule. add that as a gating condition so we don't roll on transient cache churn alone. also add a manual hold if any customer SLA-owner pings.

anna: agreed. final rollback checklist: (1) auto-rollback if p95 > 1.1s for 3m OR 5xx > 0.5% for 3m OR (kv_miss_rate > baseline*1.1 AND p95 > 1.1s); (2) manual rollback on customer SLA-owner request; (3) rollback action: pin routing back to previous policy, restore kv_cache_ttl=600, promote old batching_window=25ms.

deploy-bot: canary complete (t+15m). metrics within thresholds. status -> PROMOTING. next step: staged promotion to 50% traffic in 10m. promotion_id=promote-7341592653.

priya: eval run: small divergence on one prompt (formatting whitespace), not user-visible. tracking but not blocking. link to diff: https://evals.internal/diff/7341592653

devex-jamie: draft release note: "Reduced batching window and adjusted routing bias to prioritize fast-lex-v1; decreased KV cache TTL to accelerate cache turnover. Minor potential cost impact for sub-100-token requests. Monitoring in place; auto-rollback thresholds defined." i'll tidy and land the docs patch.

anna: thanks all — hands-off unless thresholds trigger. i'll post a post-deploy summary in #eng-releases once the 50% step stabilizes. :thumbsup:
